name: pry
title: Pry — Universal Web Scraper
description: Scrape any website with 12-tier automatic fallback. Bypasses Cloudflare, DataDome, Akamai, and other anti-bot systems. Self-hosted, no API keys needed.

urls.title: URLs to scrape
urls.description: One or more URLs to scrape. Each URL is processed through up to 12 fallback tiers.

crawl.title: Crawl linked pages
crawl.description: If enabled, follows same-domain links and scrapes them too (up to max_pages total).

max_pages.title: Max pages to scrape
max_pages.description: Maximum number of pages to scrape (including crawl).

output_format.title: Output format
output_format.description: The output format for extracted content.

use_apify_proxies.title: Use Apify proxy
use_apify_proxies.description: Route requests through Apify's datacenter proxy.

raw_html.description: Raw HTML of the scraped page (present when status=ok).
